hints.title: Four Possible Rotations
hints.text: A matrix can be rotated clockwise 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees before returning to its original orientation.

hints.title: Rotate 90 Degrees In Place
hints.text: Rotating 90 degrees corresponds to transposing the matrix and then reversing each row.

hints.title: Equality Check
hints.text: At each of the 4 rotation states, check whether mat equals target.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Matrix dimensions are at most 10x10, so 4 rotations take negligible operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place transpose and reverse rotates the matrix in O(n^2) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks all 4 rotations (0, 90, 180, 270 degrees) properly.
